subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers use the open fork PR as the implementation path for this Google Chat `NO_REPLY` placeholder cleanup, or close it and queue a replacement fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open unmerged fork PR already closes this issue and automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR if maintainers can refresh it against current main, add proof, and handle the uneditable-branch constraint.

options.title: Close candidate and replace
options.body: Close the fork PR as non-viable, then queue a narrow replacement that preserves contributor credit where appropriate.

options.title: Leave waiting
options.body: Keep the issue open without new repair work only if maintainers expect the fork author to return with proof or updates soon.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR if maintainers can refresh it against current main, add proof, and handle the uneditable-branch constraint.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cleanup question sits in the Google Chat reply-delivery path where recent history shows the most direct ownership signal.
